### Joseph Remembered
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/joseph-remembered
Passage: Genesis 41:1-13
Points:
- Believers are never promised an easy journey and frequently endure trials and prolonged waiting.
- Joseph spent two full years forgotten in an Egyptian prison before any relief arrived.
- God sent Pharaoh disturbing dreams of cows and withered grain that no court magicians could interpret.
- The failure of Egypt's wise men compelled the cupbearer to recall Joseph and confess his past neglect.
- God's deliverance often arrives at what seems like the midnight hour, perfectly aligned with His timing.
